dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: You've come to the right person. My family was in the mining business in the past. As a result, I have the ability to discern the quality of ore with a single glance, which earned me the moniker "Pan Guan'er."

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: I've discovered no small amount of Crystal Ores nearby in the past two days. They truly are splendid! I recall that I saw them around...

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: I've marked the locations out on your map. If you check those spots out, you're bound to reap quite the harvest!
